title.zh: 韩国推迟原定于明年1月实施的加密资产所得税征收
title.en: 韩国推迟原定于明年1月实施的加密资产所得税征收

current_state.zh: South Korea's presidential office has decided to again postpone the crypto asset income tax originally set to take effect in January 2027, citing the pending CARF information-exchange timeline and concerns that taxing early would concentrate the burden on domestic exchange users.
current_state.en: South Korea's presidential office has decided to again postpone the crypto asset income tax originally set to take effect in January 2027, citing the pending CARF information-exchange timeline and concerns that taxing early would concentrate the burden on domestic exchange users.
